PREFIX = "fee-composition-e2ab-root-1"
PRIVATE = ROOT / ".tmp/ash-fee-composition-root-prep-6789-20261018/candidate_files"
OLD = "apps/simulated_trading/fee_policy_v2_composition.py"
COMPOSITION = "apps/simulated_trading/execution_settlement_composition.py"
COMMAND = "apps/simulated_trading/management/commands/create_simulated_fee_policy_v2.py"
TEST = "tests/unit/simulated_trading/test_execution_settlement_composition.py"
OWNED = [OLD, COMPOSITION, COMMAND, TEST]


def git(*args: str, index: Path | None = None, payload: bytes | None = None) -> bytes:
    env = dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0")
    if index is not None:
        env["GIT_INDEX_FILE"] = str(index)
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-c", "core.safecrlf=false", *args], cwd=ROOT,
        env=env, input=payload, check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE).stdout


def sha(path: Path, *, lf: bool = False) -> str | None:
    if not path.is_file():
        return None
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return hashlib.sha256(raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n") if lf else raw).hexdigest()


def shape(path: Path) -> tuple[str, list[tuple[str, str, str | None]]]:
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    imports = []
    body = []
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)):
            module = "" if isinstance(node, ast.Import) else "." * node.level + (node.module or "")
            imports.extend((module, item.name, item.asname) for item in node.names)
        else:
            body.append(node)
    tree.body = body
    return ast.dump(tree), sorted(imports, key=repr)

    proof = {}

def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha(raw: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def lf_sha(raw: bytes) -> str:
    return sha(raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n"))


def read_json(path: Path) -> tuple[object, bytes]:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8")), raw


def git_env(worktree: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    return dict(os.environ, GIT_DIR=str(ROOT / ".git"), GIT_INDEX_FILE=str(ROOT / ".git" / "index"),
                GIT_WORK_TREE=str(worktree), GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0")


def git_bytes(args: list[str], worktree: Path = ROOT) -> bytes:
    return subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-c", "core.safecrlf=false", *args], cwd=worktree, env=git_env(worktree),
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=True,
    ).stdout


def git_text(args: list[str], worktree: Path = ROOT) -> str:
    return git_bytes(args, worktree).decode("utf-8").rstrip("\r\n")


def inside(path: Path, parent: Path) -> bool:
    return path.resolve().is_relative_to(parent.resolve())


def junit_details(path: Path, expected_files: list[str]) -> dict[str, object]:
    cases = list(ET.parse(path).iter("testcase"))
    per_file: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
    mapped = 0
    for name in expected_files:
        module = Path(name).with_suffix("").as_posix().replace("/", ".")
        matched = [
            case for case in cases
            if case.attrib.get("classname", "") == module
            or case.attrib.get("classname", "").startswith(module + ".")
        ]
        failed = sum(case.find("failure") is not None for case in matched)
        errors = sum(case.find("error") is not None for case in matched)
        skipped = sum(case.find("skipped") is not None for case in matched)
        per_file[name] = {
            "total": len(matched), "passed": len(matched) - failed - errors - skipped,
            "failed": failed, "errors": errors, "skipped": skipped,
        }
        mapped += len(matched)
    require(mapped == len(cases), f"unmapped JUnit cases: {path.name}")
    totals = {
        "total": len(cases), "passed": sum(item["passed"] for item in per_file.values()),
        "failed": sum(item["failed"] for item in per_file.values()),
        "errors": sum(item["errors"] for item in per_file.values()),
        "skipped": sum(item["skipped"] for item in per_file.values()),
        "per_file": per_file, "case_names": [case.attrib.get("name", "") for case in cases],
    }
    require(all(item["total"] > 0 for item in per_file.values()), f"JUnit file coverage missing: {path.name}")
    return totals


def artifact(path: Path, raw: bytes | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
    content = path.read_bytes() if raw is None else raw
    return {"path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": sha(content), "content_utf8": content.decode("utf-8")}

def verify_green_qa(ref: dict[str, object], ref_raw: bytes, proof_raw: bytes,
                    review_raw: bytes, build_raw: bytes, build_log_raw: bytes) -> dict[str, object]:
    result, result_raw = read_json(QA_RESULT)
    driver_raw = QA_DRIVER.read_bytes()
    require(result["status"] == "passed" and result["base"] == BASE
            and result["source_tree"] == SOURCE_TREE and result["source_commit"] == SOURCE_COMMIT
            and result["all_expected_exit_zero"] is True and result["command_inventory_valid"] is True
            and result["group_errors"] == {}, "green QA did not pass the frozen source")
    require(result["settings_content_logged"] is False
            and result["main_index_raw_sha256"] == ref["main_index_raw_sha256"]
            and result["qa_driver_raw_sha256"] == sha(driver_raw)
            and result["reference_raw_sha256"] == sha(ref_raw)
            and result["module_map_lf_sha256"] == MODULE_MAP_LF
            and result["module_map_review_raw_sha256"] == sha(review_raw)
            and result["module_map_build_report_raw_sha256"] == sha(build_raw)
            and result["module_map_build_log_raw_sha256"] == sha(build_log_raw), "QA evidence binding mismatch")
    records = result["records"]
    require(len(records) == 19 and {item["label"] for item in records} == LABELS, "expected all 19 checks")
    require(all(item["ok"] is True and item["exit_code"] == item["expected_exit"] == 0 for item in records),
            "one or more checks did not exit zero")
    junit_reports: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    logs: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for item in records:
        log = Path(item["log"]).resolve()
        require(inside(log, QA_LOG_DIR) and log.is_file(), f"QA log missing/outside pinned directory: {item['label']}")
        log_raw = log.read_bytes()
        require(sha(log_raw) == item["log_sha256"], f"QA log hash mismatch: {item['label']}")
        header = (f"source_tree={SOURCE_TREE}\nsource_commit={SOURCE_COMMIT}\n"
                  f"command={json.dumps(item['command'])}\n").encode("utf-8")
        require(log_raw.startswith(header), f"QA log identity/command mismatch: {item['label']}")
        require(sha(log_raw[len(header):]) == item["stdout_sha256"], f"QA stdout hash mismatch: {item['label']}")
        logs.append({"label": item["label"], "path": str(log.relative_to(ROOT)),
                     "sha256": sha(log_raw), "content_utf8": log_raw.decode("utf-8")})
        if item["label"] not in JUNIT_FILES:
            continue
        junit = Path(item["junit"]).resolve()
        require(inside(junit, Path(str(ref["export"])) / ".tmp") and junit.is_file(),
                f"JUnit missing/outside frozen export: {item['label']}")
        junit_raw = junit.read_bytes()
        require(sha(junit_raw) == item["junit_sha256"], f"JUnit hash mismatch: {item['label']}")
        details = junit_details(junit, JUNIT_FILES[item["label"]])
        summary = item["junit_summary"]
        require(details["total"] > 0 and details["passed"] == details["total"]
                and details["failed"] == details["errors"] == details["skipped"] == 0
                and summary["total"] == details["total"] and summary["passed"] == details["passed"]
                and summary["skipped"] == [] and summary["missing_files"] == []
                and summary["per_file"] == details["per_file"], f"JUnit is not complete/pass-only: {item['label']}")
        if item["label"] == "fee-policy-sqlite-components":
            require("test_command_preview_then_apply_and_exact_replay" in details["case_names"],
                    "preview/apply/replay component test did not pass")
        junit_reports[item["label"]] = {
            **details, "path": str(junit.relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": sha(junit_raw),
            "content_utf8": junit_raw.decode("utf-8"),
        }
    require(set(junit_reports) == set(JUNIT_FILES), "expected all three JUnit reports")
    return {
        "result": artifact(QA_RESULT, result_raw), "driver": artifact(QA_DRIVER, driver_raw),
        "reference": artifact(REF, ref_raw), "source_proof": artifact(PROOF, proof_raw),
        "module_map_review": artifact(MAP_REVIEW, review_raw), "module_map_build": artifact(MAP_BUILD, build_raw),
        "module_map_build_log": artifact(MAP_BUILD_LOG, build_log_raw),
        "logs": logs, "junit": junit_reports, "records": records,
    }

    mapped = 0
    for name in expected_files:
        module = Path(name).with_suffix("").as_posix().replace("/", ".")
        matched = [
            case for case in cases
            if case.attrib.get("classname", "") == module
            or case.attrib.get("classname", "").startswith(module + ".")
        ]
        failed = sum(case.find("failure") is not None for case in matched)
        errors = sum(case.find("error") is not None for case in matched)
        skipped = sum(case.find("skipped") is not None for case in matched)
        per_file[name] = {
            "total": len(matched), "passed": len(matched) - failed - errors - skipped,
            "failed": failed, "errors": errors, "skipped": skipped,
        }
        mapped += len(matched)
    require(mapped == len(cases), f"unmapped JUnit cases: {path.name}")
    totals = {
        "total": len(cases), "passed": sum(item["passed"] for item in per_file.values()),
        "failed": sum(item["failed"] for item in per_file.values()),
        "errors": sum(item["errors"] for item in per_file.values()),
        "skipped": sum(item["skipped"] for item in per_file.values()),
        "per_file": per_file, "case_names": [case.attrib.get("name", "") for case in cases],

                    review_raw: bytes, build_raw: bytes, build_log_raw: bytes) -> dict[str, object]:
    result, result_raw = read_json(QA_RESULT)
    driver_raw = QA_DRIVER.read_bytes()
    require(result["status"] == "passed" and result["base"] == BASE
            and result["source_tree"] == SOURCE_TREE and result["source_commit"] == SOURCE_COMMIT
            and result["all_expected_exit_zero"] is True and result["command_inventory_valid"] is True
            and result["group_errors"] == {}, "green QA did not pass the frozen source")
    require(result["settings_content_logged"] is False
            and result["main_index_raw_sha256"] == ref["main_index_raw_sha256"]
            and result["qa_driver_raw_sha256"] == sha(driver_raw)
            and result["reference_raw_sha256"] == sha(ref_raw)
            and result["module_map_lf_sha256"] == MODULE_MAP_LF
            and result["module_map_review_raw_sha256"] == sha(review_raw)
            and result["module_map_build_report_raw_sha256"] == sha(build_raw)
            and result["module_map_build_log_raw_sha256"] == sha(build_log_raw), "QA evidence binding mismatch")
    records = result["records"]
    require(len(records) == 19 and {item["label"] for item in records} == LABELS, "expected all 19 checks")
    require(all(item["ok"] is True and item["exit_code"] == item["expected_exit"] == 0 for item in records),
            "one or more checks did not exit zero")
    junit_reports: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    logs: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for item in records:
        log = Path(item["log"]).resolve()
        require(inside(log, QA_LOG_DIR) and log.is_file(), f"QA log missing/outside pinned directory: {item['label']}")
        log_raw = log.read_bytes()
        require(sha(log_raw) == item["log_sha256"], f"QA log hash mismatch: {item['label']}")
        header = (f"source_tree={SOURCE_TREE}\nsource_commit={SOURCE_COMMIT}\n"
                  f"command={json.dumps(item['command'])}\n").encode("utf-8")
        require(log_raw.startswith(header), f"QA log identity/command mismatch: {item['label']}")
        require(sha(log_raw[len(header):]) == item["stdout_sha256"], f"QA stdout hash mismatch: {item['label']}")
        logs.append({"label": item["label"], "path": str(log.relative_to(ROOT)),
                     "sha256": sha(log_raw), "content_utf8": log_raw.decode("utf-8")})
        if item["label"] not in JUNIT_FILES:
            continue
        junit = Path(item["junit"]).resolve()
        require(inside(junit, Path(str(ref["export"])) / ".tmp") and junit.is_file(),
                f"JUnit missing/outside frozen export: {item['label']}")
        junit_raw = junit.read_bytes()
        require(sha(junit_raw) == item["junit_sha256"], f"JUnit hash mismatch: {item['label']}")
        details = junit_details(junit, JUNIT_FILES[item["label"]])
        summary = item["junit_summary"]
        require(details["total"] > 0 and details["passed"] == details["total"]
                and details["failed"] == details["errors"] == details["skipped"] == 0
                and summary["total"] == details["total"] and summary["passed"] == details["passed"]
                and summary["skipped"] == [] and summary["missing_files"] == []
                and summary["per_file"] == details["per_file"], f"JUnit is not complete/pass-only: {item['label']}")
        if item["label"] == "fee-policy-sqlite-components":
            require("test_command_preview_then_apply_and_exact_replay" in details["case_names"],
                    "preview/apply/replay component test did not pass")
        junit_reports[item["label"]] = {
            **details, "path": str(junit.relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": sha(junit_raw),
            "content_utf8": junit_raw.decode("utf-8"),
        }
    require(set(junit_reports) == set(JUNIT_FILES), "expected all three JUnit reports")
    return {
        "result": artifact(QA_RESULT, result_raw), "driver": artifact(QA_DRIVER, driver_raw),
        "reference": artifact(REF, ref_raw), "source_proof": artifact(PROOF, proof_raw),
        "module_map_review": artifact(MAP_REVIEW, review_raw), "module_map_build": artifact(MAP_BUILD, build_raw),
        "module_map_build_log": artifact(MAP_BUILD_LOG, build_log_raw),
        "logs": logs, "junit": junit_reports, "records": records,
    }

def junit_details(path: Path, expected_files: list[str]) -> dict[str, object]:
    cases = list(ET.parse(path).iter("testcase"))
    per_file: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
    mapped = 0
    for name in expected_files:
        module = Path(name).with_suffix("").as_posix().replace("/", ".")
        matched = [
            case for case in cases
            if case.attrib.get("classname", "") == module
            or case.attrib.get("classname", "").startswith(module + ".")
        ]
        failed = sum(case.find("failure") is not None for case in matched)
        errors = sum(case.find("error") is not None for case in matched)
        skipped = sum(case.find("skipped") is not None for case in matched)
        per_file[name] = {
            "total": len(matched), "passed": len(matched) - failed - errors - skipped,
            "failed": failed, "errors": errors, "skipped": skipped,
        }
        mapped += len(matched)
    require(mapped == len(cases), f"unmapped JUnit cases: {path.name}")
    totals = {
        "total": len(cases), "passed": sum(item["passed"] for item in per_file.values()),
        "failed": sum(item["failed"] for item in per_file.values()),
        "errors": sum(item["errors"] for item in per_file.values()),
        "skipped": sum(item["skipped"] for item in per_file.values()),
        "per_file": per_file, "case_names": [case.attrib.get("name", "") for case in cases],
    }
    require(all(item["total"] > 0 for item in per_file.values()), f"JUnit file coverage missing: {path.name}")

"""Check the recorded Fee composition batch without staging or committing any paths."""

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PREFIX = "fee-composition-e2ab-root-1"
BASE = "e2ab295ac39963b08187131d9a4a412614316f1a"
TMP = ROOT / ".tmp"
LOGS = TMP / f"{PREFIX}-postdoc-logs"
RESULT = TMP / f"{PREFIX}-postdoc-result.json"
REF = TMP / f"{PREFIX}-reference.json"
PLAN = "docs/plans/a-share-usability-implementation-plan-2026-10-16.md"
REGISTRY = "governance/active_plan_registry.json"
CHECKPOINT = "docs/testing/a-share-usability-fee-composition-consolidation-2026-10-18.json"
BUNDLE = "artifacts/a-share-usability/ash01/fee-composition-consolidation-evidence-2026-10-18.json"


def sha(path: Path) -> str | None:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if path.is_file() else None


def git(*args: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=ROOT,
        env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"), check=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE).stdout.decode("utf-8").rstrip("\r\n")


def main() -> int:
    assert sys.argv[1:] == ["--run"] and not RESULT.exists() and not LOGS.exists()
    ref = json.loads(REF.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    qa = json.loads((TMP / f"{PREFIX}-qa-result.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert qa["status"] == "passed" and qa["command_inventory_valid"] is True
    owned = [*ref["owned_paths"], "governance/module_map.json", PLAN, REGISTRY, CHECKPOINT, BUNDLE]
    assert len(owned) == len(set(owned)) == 9
    assert git("rev-parse", "HEAD") == BASE and git("branch", "--show-current") == "dev/next-development"
    assert not git("diff", "--cached", "--name-only")
    assert sha(ROOT / ".git/index") == ref["main_index_raw_sha256"]
    old = json.loads(git("show", f"{BASE}:{REGISTRY}"))
    new = json.loads((ROOT / REGISTRY).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    expected = json.loads(json.dumps(old))
    assert old["version"] == "2026-10-18.v263" and new["version"] == "2026-10-18.v264"
    expected["version"] = new["version"]
    for row in expected["workstreams"]:
        if row["id"] == "a-share-usability":
            row["next_gate"] = next(x["next_gate"] for x in new["workstreams"] if x["id"] == row["id"])
    assert new == expected
    assert new["execution_focus"]["unit_id"] == "ASH-02"
    assert new["closure_backlog"]["version"] == "2026-10-18.v76" and len(new["closure_backlog"]["units"]) == 79
    assert (ROOT / PLAN).read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n").startswith(git("show", f"{BASE}:{PLAN}").encode("utf-8"))
    assert "### 19.59" in (ROOT / PLAN).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for path, value in ref["source_lf_sha256"].items():
        actual = ROOT / path
        assert (hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() if actual.is_file() else None) == value
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "governance/module_map.json").read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest() == "9491bb81801106cdc7ee6fa33fbe7b82caa72832863863019640609620e14553"
    for path, value in ref["protected_raw_sha256"].items():
        assert sha(ROOT / path) == value
        assert git("status", "--porcelain=v1", "--", path) == ref["protected_status"][path]
    before = {path: sha(ROOT / path) for path in owned}
    visible_before = set(line[3:] for line in git("status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all").splitlines())
    assert git("check-ignore", "--", BUNDLE) == BUNDLE
    assert visible_before == (set(owned) - {BUNDLE}) | set(ref["protected_status"])
    driver = sha(Path(__file__))
    environment = dict(os.environ, PYTHONUTF8="1", PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8", PYTEST_ADDOPTS="",
        GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0", DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE="ash_formal_calendar_sqlite_settings",
        PYTHONPATH=os.pathsep.join((str(ROOT), str(Path(ref["export"]) / ".tmp"), str(TMP))))
    LOGS.mkdir()
    junit = LOGS / "registry-tests.xml"
    commands = {
        "registry": ["scripts/check_active_plan_registry.py"],
        "registry-tests": ["-m", "pytest", "tests/unit/test_active_plan_registry.py", "-q", "--no-migrations",
            "--ds=ash_formal_calendar_sqlite_settings", "-p", "ash_domain_local_network_fence",
            f"--basetemp=.tmp/pytest-{PREFIX}-postdoc", f"--junitxml={junit}"],
        "full-governance": ["scripts/check_governance_consistency.py", "--format", "json",
            "--write-report", f".tmp/{PREFIX}-postdoc-governance.json"],
    }

    def run(label: str, args: list[str]) -> dict[str, object]:
        log = LOGS / f"{label}.txt"
        command = [str(ROOT / "agomtradepro/Scripts/python.exe"), "-X", "utf8", *args]
        print(f"starting postdoc/{label}", flush=True)
        with log.open("wb") as stream:
            stream.write((json.dumps({"base": BASE, "source_tree": ref["source_tree"], "command": command}) + "\n").encode())
            stream.flush()
            outcome = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=environment, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        record = {"label": label, "command": command, "exit_code": outcome.returncode, "log": str(log), "log_raw_sha256": sha(log)}
        print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
        return record

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(run, label, args) for label, args in commands.items()]
        records = [future.result() for future in futures]
    cases = list(ET.parse(junit).iter("testcase")) if junit.is_file() else []
    test_ok = len(cases) == 8 and all(not any(case.find(tag) is not None for tag in ("failure", "error", "skipped")) for case in cases)
    unchanged = before == {path: sha(ROOT / path) for path in owned} and sha(Path(__file__)) == driver
    unchanged = unchanged and sha(ROOT / ".git/index") == ref["main_index_raw_sha256"] and git("rev-parse", "HEAD") == BASE
    unchanged = unchanged and not git("diff", "--cached", "--name-only")
    unchanged = unchanged and set(line[3:] for line in git("status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all").splitlines()) == visible_before
    for path, value in ref["protected_raw_sha256"].items():
        unchanged = unchanged and sha(ROOT / path) == value and git("status", "--porcelain=v1", "--", path) == ref["protected_status"][path]
    ok = unchanged and test_ok and len(records) == 3 and all(item["exit_code"] == 0 for item in records)
    report = {"status": "passed" if ok else "failed", "base": BASE, "source_tree": ref["source_tree"],
        "records": records, "owned_paths": owned, "owned_raw_sha256": before, "inputs_unchanged": unchanged,
        "registry_test_count": len(cases), "registry_tests_all_passed_without_skips": test_ok,
        "junit": str(junit), "junit_raw_sha256": sha(junit), "driver_raw_sha256": driver}
    RESULT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"result": str(RESULT), "status": report["status"]}), flush=True)
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
